title: Open source AI model generates unlimited length videos using #AI #OpenSource #VideoCreation
description:
SkyReels V2 is a new free, open-source AI video generation model from China, designed to create videos of unlimited length. Unlike most existing AI tools that are limited to short clips of around 15 seconds, SkyReels V2 leverages a technique called diffusion forcing. This method allows the model to extend videos smoothly by using existing frames to inform what should happen next, avoiding the typical disjointed effect of stitching separate video segments together. The model supports generation from simple text prompts or reference images and produces video quality comparable to premium alternatives like Kling and Runway. Users can either download the model weights from Hugging Face and run it locally—requiring a high-end GPU such as the RTX 4090—or use the more accessible official SkyReels website, which provides free credits for immediate use. This flexibility makes advanced, long-form AI video generation more accessible for both developers and creators. The release of SkyReels V2 pushes the boundaries of AI video generation by addressing key technical limits and offering an open-source, high-quality alternative. Its potential to democratize video content creation and innovation has led to significant interest in both consumer and professional video production markets. #SkyReels #AIVideoGeneration #OpenSourceAI
